title: Enterprise ask lattice and scope snapshot for Sales/CS intake
creator: Anika Patel
description: Create a repeatable, short-form aggregation and first-pass scoping artifact for Sales/CS-enterprise feature asks. The goal is to reduce back-and-forth between CS/AE and PMs by providing a structured 'lattice' that groups asks by business capability, surface area, and implementation complexity so PMs and Eng can make faster intake decisions or kick off scoped discovery. Deliverables: 1) an intake template (single page) for CS reps, 2) an internal rubric for PM/ENG prioritization and initial sizing, 3) a lightweight dashboard to track outstanding enterprise asks and their disposition.
acceptance_criteria: One-page CS intake template tested with 3 AEs and updated with feedback
Internal rubric documented with at least 6 scoring factors (impact, revenue risk, security, complexity, strategic alignment, reuse) and sample scoring for 4 real asks
Scoping snapshot created for top 8 queued enterprise asks with preliminary estimate band (S/M/L) and suggested stakeholders
A short Confluence playbook linked from the CS intake page describing next steps and SLA for PM response (48 business hours)
comments: 2026-02-28 - Anika Patel: Kickoff note. CS reported backlog of ~40 enterprise asks; AEs frustrated by ambiguous follow-ups. Proposal: surface quick decisions and where to route (product backlog vs. custom work).
2026-03-02 - Liam O'Connor: Drafted intake template and shared with CS leadership. Key change: require a customer impact statement and whether the ask is regulatory/compliance-related.

2026-03-04 - Priya Menon (CS lead): Feedback from AE pilot (n=3): intake too long; moved 'technical constraints' to optional. Asking for an example filled form per common ask types (integration, SSO, throughput).
2026-03-05 - Eng triage sync (notes): ENG suggested adding an initial compatibility check for Dedicated/Private (yes/no) because it affects scope heavily. Added field to template.

2026-03-07 - Design review (Lina Xu): Provided microcopy fixes to reduce ambiguity in 'value proposition' field. Recommended multi-select tags for quick grouping (billing, security, runtime, console, model-ops).

2026-03-09 - Anika: Populated lattice grouping with 12 sample asks from Sales queue; ranked top 8 by preliminary score. Decided to treat security/regulatory asks as expedited lane with dedicated triage SLA. See snapshot attached in Confluence.
2026-03-10 - Liam: Created initial dashboard view in Looker (private link) tracking 'received, triaged, scoped, declined' states. Requesting ENG to add 'feasibility' toggle to dashboard via tag sync.
decision_log: Adopted 'lattice' grouping approach: (1) business capability, (2) product surface, (3) deployment impact (hosted/dedicated/private), (4) estimated complexity band.
Scoring factors finalized: customer size (ARR), technical risk, frequency of ask across accounts, revenue immediacy, regulatory requirement, required Eng-hours estimate.
Expedited lane rule: any ask flagged as 'regulatory' or 'security-critical' moves to expedited triage with 3-business-day turnaround and dedicated Eng reviewer.

ENG: add feasibility tag sync to Looker dashboard and verify sample mapping for Dedicated/Private (owner: Mateo) - due 2026-03-18
PM: run intake review meeting for top 8 asks and produce scoping snapshot (owner: Anika) - meeting scheduled 2026-03-16
